subject: Math

errors.description: The candidate chart is rendered as a small 600×400 panel on the right side of the page, while the ground-truth visualization fills almost the entire viewport with a large plotting area and controls.
The candidate includes an extra large page-level title to the left of the chart, in addition to the chart title. The ground truth has only one centered title at the top of the visualization.

The green polyline connecting the quadratic points is missing in the candidate; the candidate shows only separate scatter markers, whereas the ground truth connects the five points with a thick green line.
The candidate plots four extra intermediate points at x = -3, -1, 1, and 3. The ground truth shows only five draggable points at x = -4, -2, 0, 2, and 4.
The point markers have the wrong appearance: the candidate uses small solid dark gray dots, while the ground truth uses larger circular markers with a red outline/white center style.
The coordinate labels above the plotted points are missing in the candidate. In the ground truth, each point is labeled, such as "(-4, 16)", "(0, 0)", and "(4, 16)".

The axis ranges and tick scheme do not match. The ground truth x-axis spans about -5 to 5 and the y-axis spans -2 to 18 with labeled ticks including -2, 0, 5, 10, 15, and 18; the candidate chart shows a narrower x-axis around -4 to 4 and a different y tick interval pattern.
The axis name labels are missing in the candidate: the ground truth shows a blue "x" label at the lower right and a red "y" label at the upper left.
The light gray gridlines visible across the ground-truth plot are absent in the candidate chart.

The axis and tick styling colors do not match the ground truth: the ground-truth x-axis and tick labels are blue and the y-axis and tick labels are red, while the candidate uses neutral gray/black axis styling.
The interactive zoom sliders are missing in the candidate. The ground truth has a horizontal slider along the bottom and a vertical slider along the right side of the chart.
The candidate adds a bordered chart panel with a visible gray outline and shadow, whereas the ground truth chart area has no enclosing gray panel border or drop-shadow effect.

subject: Math

errors.description: The whole gauge is much smaller and shifted left in the candidate, with large empty/right-side content beside it, whereas the ground truth gauge is large and centered on the canvas.
The gauge scale ends at 3.6 in the candidate, while the ground truth scale extends to 4; the candidate shows a bottom-right tick label of 3.6 instead of the ground truth's 4.

The colored range breakpoints are wrong: in the ground truth the red segment begins around 2.8, but in the candidate it begins around 2.4, making the green segment too short and the red segment too long.
The colored gauge arc is visibly much thicker in the candidate than in the ground truth, changing the characteristic thin-ring appearance.
The ground truth has many small minor tick marks around the gauge scale, but the candidate largely lacks those dense minor tick marks, leaving only sparse major markings.

The pointer does not match the ground truth needle: the ground truth has a dark, slim needle starting near the center, while the candidate shows a red, broader custom pointer displaced toward the right with a thin extension outside the arc.

The internal value/title placement is wrong: in the ground truth the value "3.14" appears above the title "π Approx." near the lower center, while in the candidate "π Approx." is higher and "3.14" is below it.
The displayed value text is red in the candidate, but the ground truth value "3.14" is dark navy/black.
The candidate includes an extra separate text block to the right of the gauge showing "3.14" and "π Approx.", which is not present in the ground truth.

subject: Geography

errors.description: The plotted data values are wrong. In the ground truth, Region A rises to 168 in 2021 and has intermediate values such as 128, 135, 143, 151, 160, while the candidate plots a lower series ending at 160 with different intermediate points; Region B also differs at points such as 2017 and 2018.

The endpoint min/max mark-point pin annotations are missing. The ground truth shows large colored pin markers labeled 120 and 168 for Region A and 90 and 121 for Region B, but the candidate only shows ordinary circular data markers.

The dashed horizontal reference/mark lines are missing. The ground truth includes dashed average lines labeled 143.57 and 105.43 with arrowheads, plus a red dashed max reference line labeled Max; none of these reference lines or arrows appear in the candidate.
The toolbox controls are missing. The ground truth has a row of small chart toolbox icons in the upper-right corner, while the candidate has no such controls.

The y-axis labeling/unit format is wrong. The ground truth tick labels include the unit suffix, such as “180 K”, “150 K”, and “0 K”, while the candidate shows plain numeric ticks such as 180, 150, and 0.
The candidate adds an extra y-axis title, “Population (K)”, at the upper left of the plot. The ground truth has no separate y-axis title there; the unit is instead shown in each tick label.

The legend is incorrectly positioned and overlaps the title area. In the ground truth, the legend sits clearly below the title; in the candidate, the legend entries appear on top of or immediately adjacent to the title, reducing readability.

The chart is rendered much smaller than the ground truth. The ground-truth plot fills nearly the full wide canvas, while the candidate is constrained to a smaller 800-by-600 chart with large unused space around it.
The ordinary data markers have the wrong appearance. In the ground truth, the series points are hollow circular markers with a visible outline, while the candidate uses small solid filled circles.
The horizontal gridlines use the wrong style. The ground truth gridlines are dashed gray lines, while the candidate gridlines appear as solid light lines.
The page/chart background color is wrong. The ground truth background is white, while the candidate uses a light gray page background across the visible canvas.

errors.description: The Components element has the wrong visual type. The ground truth shows a stack of magenta document/tape-like sheets, while the candidate renders it as a red-purple cylinder.
The dashed container borders have the wrong styling: the ground truth uses thin dashed rounded rectangles, while the candidate uses much thicker dashed boxes with square corners.

The Webpack build icon is wrong. The ground truth shows a small stylized cube/package icon with the label 'Webpack build' underneath; the candidate shows a large transparent box-like cube with the text placed inside the cube.
The arrow between app.js and Server entity points the wrong way. In the ground truth, app.js points to Server entity; in the candidate, the arrow points from Server entity down to app.js.

errors.description: The signpost cross-section annulus is not shaded like the ground truth. In the ground truth the outer ring is light gray with a white inner opening, but in the candidate both circles are unfilled/white outlines.

The outer diameter dimension in the cross-section is missing the two vertical extension lines seen in the ground truth above the ring; the candidate only shows the horizontal double-headed arrow and label.
The steel post is rendered as a rectangular/box-like member in the candidate, whereas the ground truth shows a cylindrical tube/post with curved circular cross-section cues.
The fixed support is visually detached below the steel post in the candidate, leaving a gap, while in the ground truth the post emerges directly from and is connected to the cylindrical support.
The horizontal sign/beam lacks the ground-truth gray face shading. The ground truth has differently shaded top, side, and front faces, but the candidate beam faces are almost entirely white.

The coordinate axes are placed differently. In the ground truth the long x and y axes originate near the fixed support/base and the z axis rises near the post top, while in the candidate the x and y axes are small arrows attached near the right end/top of the beam.
The lateral distributed load arrows for $w_x$ point the wrong way. In the ground truth they point toward the post/sign from the left, while in the candidate they point leftward away from the post.
The sloped envelope line for the triangular $w_x$ distribution is absent in the candidate; the ground truth shows a prominent diagonal boundary connecting the varying lateral load arrows.

The horizontal reference line above the top distributed load $w_z$ is missing. The ground truth has a line spanning above the beam with downward arrows attached, but the candidate only shows separate downward arrows on the beam top.

The concentrated force arrows at the beam-post joint have the wrong orientations. In the ground truth $F_{z1}$ is a vertical downward load along the post and $F_{y1}$ is a diagonal/upward load toward the beam, while in the candidate both are short opposing arrows along the beam-depth direction.

Several dimension annotations are placed or scaled unlike the ground truth: $h_1$ does not extend from the support to the beam bottom, $h_2$ is much shorter, and $x_1$ is drawn as a short segment near the post rather than spanning from the post toward the interior point of the beam.

errors.description: The plotted surface represents the wrong function/geometry. The ground truth is a bowl-shaped parametric paraboloid-like surface with its lowest point below 0, while the candidate shows a radially increasing cone-like surface over a square domain with a different height pattern.
errors.description_zh: 所绘曲面表示了错误的函数/几何形状。GT 图像是一个碗状的参数化类抛物面曲面，其最低点低于 0，而 Candidate 图像显示的是一个在方形定义域上径向增高的类圆锥曲面，具有不同的高度模式。

errors.description: The 3D viewpoint is different. In the ground truth the surface is viewed from the opposite side with the ξ axis running along the front-right edge and the η axis on the left, while the candidate is rotated so the axes and surface face a different direction.

errors.description: The vertical axis range is wrong. The ground truth includes a lower bound below zero and the surface minimum is visibly below the 0 tick, while the candidate z axis starts at 0 and clips the displayed vertical range to 0–6.
errors.description_zh: 纵轴范围错误。GT 图像包含一个低于零的下界，且曲面最小值明显低于 0 刻度，而 Candidate 图像的 z 轴从 0 开始，并将显示的垂直范围裁剪为 0–6。

errors.description: The surface mesh lines are missing. The ground truth surface has a prominent dark blue wire grid over the surface, while the candidate surface is smoothly shaded with no visible mesh grid.

errors.description: The colorbar has the wrong size. In the ground truth the colorbar is a short bar near the lower right of the plot, while in the candidate it spans nearly the full plot height.

subject: Geography

errors.description: The INS grouping is structurally wrong: in the ground truth the dashed pale-yellow INS container encloses the IMU sub-container and the navigation-equations block, while in the candidate the label INS appears in a separate pale-yellow rectangle on the far right and is not the enclosing container for the system.

The IMU contents are not grouped correctly: the ground truth has a small dashed blue IMU sub-container containing the Gyros and Accelero-meters blocks, whereas the candidate shows a very large standalone IMU rectangle on the left and places the Gyros/accelerometer-related blocks outside it in a separate middle column.

The accelerometer block is effectively obscured in the candidate: the ground truth clearly shows a separate Accelero-meters sensor box below Gyros, but in the candidate the pink Navigation equations rectangle covers the middle blue accelerometer rectangle and its label overlaps at the same position, making the accelerometer element not visibly distinct.

The main component sizes are drastically wrong: the ground truth uses compact sensor boxes and a narrow vertical Navigation equations block, while the candidate uses large full-height panels and a much larger pink block occupying most of the middle column.

The output arrows have the wrong orientation: the ground truth has four horizontal arrows extending rightward from the Navigation equations block, whereas the candidate shows four vertical upward arrows inside the right-hand INS rectangle.

The output arrows are not connected to the Navigation equations block: in the ground truth all four outputs originate from the right edge of the pink block, but in the candidate they are detached and placed inside the separate right-side INS panel.

The descriptive output labels are missing: the ground truth labels the four output arrows as Velocity, Attitude, Horisontal position, and Depth, but the candidate only shows the mathematical symbols next to the arrows.
The accelerometer sensor label text is wrong: the ground truth reads “Accelero-meters” split with a hyphen across two lines, while the candidate uses “Accelerometers” as a single word.

The rounded-corner styling is missing from key containers: the ground truth shows rounded corners on the outer INS rectangle, inner IMU rectangle, and Navigation equations block, but the candidate draws these as sharp-cornered rectangles.

errors.description: The overall 3D viewpoint/projection is wrong: in the ground truth the c-axis is vertical, b extends to the right, and a slants down-left, while in the candidate a is horizontal, b is vertical, and c slants down-left, changing the spatial interpretation of the whole construction.

The semantic coloring is largely lost: the ground truth uses teal axes and point, a blue vector, a violet vector, orange unit vectors, and teal equation text, whereas the candidate renders almost everything in black.
The candidate adds four long parallel black lines representing a plane, but the ground truth has no such set of parallel plane lines; it instead shows individual vectors and construction guides.
The violet vector from the origin to the projected base point, labeled d in the ground truth, is missing from the candidate.
One of the two orange unit vectors is missing: the ground truth shows both ŝ and λ̂ starting from the same base point, while the candidate shows only a single ŝ arrow.

The remaining ŝ vector is placed incorrectly: in the ground truth it starts at the projected base point near the dashed vertical construction line, but in the candidate it starts on the horizontal a-axis and is detached from the point construction.

The marked point is in the wrong location and appearance: the ground truth point is teal and sits high above its base projection near the upper-right construction, while the candidate point is black and located much lower near the center of the diagram.

The dashed projection guides connect the wrong geometric locations: the ground truth has a vertical drop to the base point plus base-plane guides to the a and b axes and a c-level guide, whereas the candidate draws dashed segments from the point to side locations at the point height.
The α angle annotation is drawn as a large two-headed arrow and arc in the candidate, while the ground truth shows a small simple angle arc near the origin between the base direction and the a-axis.
The displayed equation is wrong: the ground truth reads c = 2a + b − 1, but the candidate reads c = 2a + b/d · 1.

errors.description: The candidate adds a full black boxed grid around every table cell, including vertical column separators and horizontal row separators. In the ground truth, the table uses booktabs-style horizontal rules only and has no internal vertical or row gridlines through the body.

The ground-truth table has prominent booktabs rules at the top, below the header, and at the bottom, while the candidate replaces them with thin cell-border strokes integrated into the grid; the top and bottom rules do not appear as the same continuous heavy horizontal lines.
The header background color is wrong: the ground truth uses a dark navy blue header, whereas the candidate header is a brighter royal blue.
The first-column body background is wrong: the ground truth uses a very pale light blue, while the candidate first column appears more lavender/purple and more saturated.
The first-column row labels are bold in the candidate, but they are regular-weight text in the ground truth.

The header cells are not aligned into one continuous rectangular header band in the candidate: different header boxes have different heights and vertical positions, creating a stepped/jagged top and bottom edge. In the ground truth, all header cells share the same top and bottom edges in a single uniform band.

Several candidate header labels are visibly hyphenated across line breaks, such as 'Develop- ment', 'Re- alism', and 'En- gagement'. The ground-truth headers break at whole words and do not show these added hyphen symbols.
The candidate table is scaled much larger vertically, with very tall body rows and substantially more whitespace inside cells. The ground-truth table has compact rows with the entries closely spaced.

The numeric entries in the candidate are right-aligned near the right borders of their cells, while the ground truth shows the numeric columns centered/decimal-aligned within open column space rather than pressed against cell edges.

subject: Economics

errors.description: The horizontal α-level divider is placed too high/at the midpoint in both candidate diagrams. In the ground truth, the α_s^B horizontal line is noticeably below the middle, making the lower regions taller than the upper regions; in the candidate, the divider splits the boxes into equal top and bottom halves.

The vertical partition locations are wrong and evenly spaced in the candidate. In the ground truth, the interest-rate lines, NV_s^A, and NV_s^B are at unequal x-positions; the candidate uses uniformly spaced vertical divisions, changing the widths of regions I–V and VI–XII.

The candidate draws closed full-height rectangles, creating extra upper-right box boundaries absent from the ground truth. In the ground truth, the top α_s^A boundary stops at NV_s^A and the NV_s^B vertical boundary rises only to α_s^B; in the candidate, the top border and right border extend across the full height to NV_s^B in both diagrams.

The NV_s^A vertical boundary is rendered dashed in the candidate but solid in the ground truth. This is visible in both diagrams at the boundary labeled NV_s^A, where the ground truth uses a solid vertical line separating the NV_s^A and NV_s^B regions.

In the right diagram, the r_L^B separator should be dotted, but the candidate renders it as a dashed line. The ground truth shows the second interest-rate separator with a dotted pattern between r_L^A and NV_s^A.

The α-level labels on the y-axis are wrong. The ground truth labels the two horizontal levels as α_s^A and α_s^B; the candidate shows an extra/wrong α_s^E at the middle level and places α_s^B down at the bottom instead.

The interest-rate labels use the wrong symbols. The ground truth has \hat{r}_L in the left diagram and r_L^A, r_L^B in the right diagram; the candidate instead labels these positions with τ_L^A and τ_L^B.

The α_s^A labels are placed above the y-axis arrow in the candidate, while in the ground truth they sit to the left of the diagram aligned with the α_s^A horizontal boundary. This makes the label-to-level association visibly incorrect in both diagrams.

errors.description: The overall 3D projection of the two layers is wrong: in the ground truth both planes are compact parallelograms with a right-up shear, while in the candidate they are much larger diagonally tilted slabs with a different viewing angle, changing the apparent layer geometry.

All circular nodes have black outlines in the candidate, whereas the ground-truth nodes are filled circles without a visible black stroke around their rims.

errors.description_zh: 在左侧物理示意图中，斜面的几何形状/朝向错误：GT 图像显示的是一个较平缓的坡道，右侧为垂直边，倾角约为 27°；而 Candidate 图像显示的是一个陡得多的三角形坡道，其顶点靠近中间，且没有垂直的滑轮支撑边。

errors.description: The block on the inclined plane is not placed or rotated correctly: in the ground truth it sits on the incline and is rotated parallel to the slope, but in the candidate it is an upright square located inside the triangle rather than aligned with the surface.
errors.description_zh: 斜面上的方块放置或旋转不正确：在 GT 图像中，它放在斜面上并旋转到与斜坡平行，但在 Candidate 图像中，它是位于三角形内部的直立正方形，而不是与表面对齐。

errors.description: The rope and hanging mass arrangement in the left schematic is wrong: the ground truth rope runs from block A along the ramp, over the pulley, then vertically downward to a hanging mass, while the candidate connects block A to a red pulley and then horizontally to a block at the right.
errors.description_zh: 左侧示意图中的绳子和悬挂重物布置错误：GT 图像中的绳子从方块 A 沿斜坡延伸，越过滑轮，然后竖直向下连接到一个悬挂重物；而 Candidate 图像将方块 A 连接到一个红色滑轮，再水平连接到右侧的一个方块。

errors.description: The left schematic's pulley is drawn with the wrong appearance: the ground truth has a black outlined wheel at the top of the ramp, whereas the candidate shows a filled red circular node detached from the ramp geometry.

errors.description_zh: 左侧示意图的滑轮绘制外观错误：GT 图像在斜坡顶部有一个黑色描边的轮子，而 Candidate 图像显示的是一个填充的红色圆形节点，并且与斜坡几何结构分离。

errors.description: The angle marker on the physical ramp is wrong: the ground truth shows a small curved arc at the base of the incline with theta nearby, while the candidate draws a large two-segment arrow along the ramp edges with theta near the middle of the triangle.
errors.description_zh: 物理斜坡上的角度标记错误：GT 图像在斜面底部附近显示了一个小的弯曲圆弧，旁边有 theta，而 Candidate 图像沿斜坡边缘画了一个大的双线段箭头，theta 位于三角形中部附近。

errors.description: The free-body diagram for block A is not rotated with the incline as in the ground truth. In the ground truth the block, x′ axis, tension, and friction are all aligned along the sloped direction, with y′ and the normal perpendicular to it; in the candidate the block is upright and the x′/T/Ffr directions are horizontal.
errors.description_zh: 块 A 的受力图没有像 GT 图像中那样随斜面旋转。在 GT 图像中，方块、x′ 轴、拉力和摩擦力都沿斜坡方向对齐，而 y′ 和支持力与其垂直；在 Candidate 图像中，方块是竖直的，且 x′/T/Ffr 方向是水平的。

errors.description: The theta indicator in the block-A free-body diagram is the wrong form and location: the ground truth has a small curved arc between the downward vertical direction and the tilted y′ axis below the block, while the candidate shows an L-shaped broken angle marker extending from the x′ direction.
errors.description_zh: block-A 受力图中的 theta 指示符形式和位置错误：GT 图像在方块下方的向下竖直方向与倾斜的 y′ 轴之间有一条小的弯曲圆弧，而 Candidate 图像显示的是一个从 x′ 方向延伸出的 L 形折角标记。

errors.description: The coordinate axes lack arrowheads in the candidate. In the ground truth the dashed x′, y′, and z axes have arrow tips showing their positive directions, but in the candidate these dashed axis lines are rendered without arrowheads.
errors.description_zh: Candidate 图像中的坐标轴缺少箭头。在 GT 图像中，虚线 x′、y′ 和 z 轴带有箭头尖以表示其正方向，但在 Candidate 图像中，这些虚线轴线在绘制时没有箭头。

review.recommendation_reason: GT/Candidate 仍可可靠比较，但部分预标注属于代码依赖、轻微风格差异或重复拆解；按下方逐 error 建议删除，其余保留。

The M_2 displacement indicator is represented incorrectly. The ground truth shows a dashed double-headed line below the M_2 housing; the candidate shows text symbols “← ⋯ →” inside the gray M_2 block instead of a dashed arrow line below it.

errors.description: The plotted function curve is substantially wrong: in the ground truth it is a thick teal quadratic with a low minimum left of η and crossing the horizontal line near η, while in the candidate it starts near the x-axis at the left edge of the blue rectangle and rises as a different black parabola.
The function curve color is wrong: the ground-truth curve is dark teal, whereas the candidate curve is black.
The blue horizontal constant line at g(η), spanning from p to q in the ground truth, is missing as a distinct stroked line in the candidate; only rectangle edges appear instead.

The shaded regions are the wrong shapes: the ground truth fills the curved areas between the quadratic curve and the horizontal line, but the candidate uses simple rectangular blocks that are not bounded by the curve.
The right shaded region has the wrong color: the ground truth uses a cyan/teal fill, while the candidate uses a purple-blue rectangle.

The axis configuration is wrong: the ground truth has a bottom x-axis with tick marks labeled p, η, q and a y tick at g(η), while the candidate uses hand-drawn axes with different extents, no corresponding tick marks, and places q as an axis-end label.

The p, η, and q labels are not in the ground-truth tick-label positions: p should be below the x-axis at the left tick, η below the central tick, and q below the right tick, but in the candidate p is below the red block, η is inside the blue rectangle, and q is placed in the plot area.
There is an extra q label at the arrow tip of the x-axis in the candidate; the ground truth only shows q as the right x-axis tick label.

subject: Physics

errors.description: The main amplifier body is oriented incorrectly: the ground truth has a right-pointing op-amp triangle with a vertical left input side and right output apex, while the candidate shows a large triangle with a bottom apex and a horizontal top edge.

The internal op-amp polarity symbols are missing. In the ground truth, a minus sign appears near the upper input and a plus sign near the lower input inside the amplifier; the candidate has no internal '+' or '−' signs.

The input connections are wrong: the ground truth has two horizontal input leads entering the left side of the op amp and labeled v− and v+, while the candidate draws two diagonal arrowed lines from the bottom apex of the triangle to the labels.

The output connection is attached to the wrong place and has the wrong form: the ground truth output is a horizontal line from the right apex with a filled dot before the vO label, whereas the candidate draws a diagonal arrow from the upper-right triangle corner and has no output dot.

The supply-voltage connections are misrepresented. In the ground truth, V+ and V− are vertical arrows connected to the top and bottom of the op amp; in the candidate they appear as horizontal bidirectional arrows extending left and right from the bottom vertex.

One of the two 'Supply Voltage' text labels is missing. The ground truth has a label beside both the upper and lower supply arrows, while the candidate shows only a single 'Supply Voltage' label at the top.

The differential-voltage arrow v_d is wrong: in the ground truth it is a short single downward arrow between the two input terminals, but in the candidate it is a vertical double-headed arrow rising from the bottom apex inside the triangle.

The Entry and Exit labels are placed incorrectly. In the ground truth, Entry is to the left of the op amp inputs and Exit is to the right of the output; in the candidate, Entry is below the triangle near the bottom vertex and Exit is below/right of the triangle rather than beside the output.

The two leader arrows for the differential side-length labels point the wrong way: in the ground truth the arrowheads point back to the surface patch, while in the candidate the black arrows point outward toward the labels.

The violet double-headed horizontal radius segment labeled r sinϑ is missing: the ground truth has a <-> connector from the z-axis to the surface point, but the candidate only shows a dashed radial line from the origin labeled r.

The outer azimuth increment label is wrong: the ground truth labels the second dashed ray as “φ + dφ” near the lower right, while the candidate shows only “dφ” near the surface and lacks the full “φ + dφ” text.

The standalone dϑ angle label is missing: the ground truth has a violet “dϑ” label between the two radial construction lines near the center of the sphere, but the candidate has no separate dϑ angular label in that location.

subject: Geography

errors.description: The accelerometer block text is split with the wrong letters: the ground truth reads “Accelero-” over “meters,” while the candidate reads “Acceler-” over “ometers.”

The right-side output math symbols use the wrong frame superscripts/subscripts. The ground truth shows velocity as v^l, attitude as R_l^b, and horizontal position as R_e^l, but the candidate shows v^I, R_b^I, and R_e^I.

The two arrows from the Gyros and Accelerometers blocks to the Navigation equations block are slanted in the candidate, whereas they are horizontal in the ground truth and align with the sensor block centers.

The group labels are placed outside their intended containers: in the ground truth, “IMU” is inside the blue IMU region and “INS” is inside the yellow INS region near the bottom, but in the candidate both labels appear below their boxes.

The right edge of the dashed INS box runs through the output-label area in the candidate, visibly crossing near the “Velocity” label and arrow. In the ground truth, the dashed INS boundary ends before the right-side labels and does not obstruct them.

The block outlines are materially different: the ground truth has thin black outlines for the sensor and navigation blocks and a dashed gray outline for the IMU container, while the candidate uses thick colored blue/red rounded outlines and a solid blue IMU container outline.
Most text in the candidate is rendered in a sans-serif style, while the ground truth uses a serif/Times-like style for the labels and block text; this is visually prominent across the whole diagram.

subject: Physics

errors.description: The circuit components are drawn with the wrong shapes: the ground truth has standard circuit symbols, including a battery source and zigzag resistor symbols for R_A, R_B, and R_load, while the candidate replaces them with rectangular outlines, V-shaped/diamond-like polylines, and box shapes.

The ground symbol at the lower left of the circuit is missing. In the ground truth, the bottom of the voltage source connects to a standard ground symbol, but the candidate only shows a short vertical line ending at the V_in label.

The directional arrows for the annotated voltages and current are missing. The ground truth shows blue voltage arrows for V_in, V_A, V_B, and V_L, plus an upward current arrow for I_in, whereas the candidate shows only plain short line segments with labels and no arrowheads.
The voltage annotations are the wrong color. In the ground truth, the voltage arrows and voltage labels are blue, while the candidate voltage labels are rendered in black.

The circuit topology is not reconstructed correctly. In the ground truth, R_A feeds a top rail and R_B and R_load are vertical parallel branches between common top and bottom rails; in the candidate, the components are arranged as separate box-like sections with triangular lower links and do not form the same shared-node parallel circuit.

The black junction dots at the resistor branch connection nodes are missing. The ground truth shows filled circular connection nodes at the top and bottom of the R_B and R_load branches, but the candidate has only line intersections with no dots.

Several labels are placed in clearly wrong positions relative to their components. For example, R_A is below a lower baseline instead of beneath the top horizontal resistor, R_B is above its branch instead of beside the vertical resistor, and V_in appears below the source rather than to its left with a vertical arrow.

subject: Computer Science

errors.description: Prominent node text uses the wrong font styling: in the ground truth, start/stop and access nodes are bold and the orange process nodes use a monospaced typewriter font, while the candidate renders these labels mostly in regular sans-serif text.

Several main vertical arrows have the wrong semantic colors: the ground truth shows Input→Validate and Validate→Database in teal and Database→Password Check in orange, but the candidate renders these main connectors in blue.
The failure-branch arrows for Invalid and Mismatch are the wrong color: in the ground truth these denial branches are red, while the candidate draws them in teal.
The conditional labels are black in the candidate, whereas the ground truth color-codes them with their branches: Valid is teal, Match is blue, and Invalid/Mismatch are red.

The denial branch routing is visibly wrong: the ground truth uses orthogonal red paths that enter Access Denied from the side, while the candidate routes Invalid and Mismatch diagonally into the top/bottom of the Access Denied box, changing the flow layout.

The candidate has unintended overlap at the Access Denied node: the Mismatch label and diagonal connector cross over the Access Denied box text, whereas the ground truth keeps the label and connector outside the box with no obstruction.

An extra maroon connector runs from Access Denied down toward End Process in the candidate. The ground truth has no direct Access Denied-to-End connector; Access Denied should route to Log Attempt instead.

errors.description: The actual circuit components are missing: the ground truth shows a battery on the left branch and zigzag resistors for R_A and R_B, while the candidate has no battery plate symbol or resistor zigzags.

The circuit topology is substantially wrong: the ground truth has one rectangular loop with R_A on the top branch and R_B on the right branch, but the candidate routes a stepped path through separate nodes at the top and middle before descending, so the labels/components are not connected in the same loop arrangement.
The V_A annotation is oriented incorrectly. In the ground truth, V_A is a horizontal arrow above R_A pointing left; in the candidate, V_A is attached to a vertical downward segment between two nodes.

The ground symbol at the lower left is missing. The ground truth shows a standard ground icon below the left branch, while the candidate replaces this with a right-side downward line and text.

errors.description_zh: 阴影等值面分组不正确：GT 图像有三个浅灰色层级多边形，包括一个较大的中间六边形以及顶部/底部三角形，但 Candidate 图像显示的是几个倾斜的四边形面板和一个小的中央面板，与这些层级不对应。

errors.description: The node layout is substantially wrong: the ground truth uses a staggered four-column matrix with g*F down-left of g*F_W, F down-left of F_W, X centered above P/Q, W at the right middle, and Q at the bottom. The X to W arrow has the wrong styling. In the ground truth it is a dashed purple horizontal arrow, but in the candidate it is a solid blue arrow.
The dashed arrow between X and P points the wrong way. The ground truth has a dashed purple arrow from X down-left to P, while the candidate has a dashed red arrow from P toward X.
The teal bottom arrow from P to Q is missing. In the ground truth P connects horizontally to Q, but the candidate has no corresponding P-to-Q teal arrow.

The blue arrow into Q is connected from the wrong node. In the ground truth the blue diagonal arrow goes from W down-left to Q, but in the candidate a blue vertical arrow goes from F to the overlapped Q/X position.

errors.description: The plotted radar values differ from the ground truth for the perfume brands, changing the polygon shapes. For example, Chanel's ground-truth profile includes Creativity 7, Longevity 6, Value 7, Popularity 8, and Packaging 9, while the candidate plots a different sequence such as Creativity 8, Longevity 7, Value 6, Popularity 7, and Packaging 8; Dior and Gucci profiles are also visibly different.

errors.description: The data point markers are missing. The ground truth shows circular markers at each category vertex on every radar polygon, while the candidate shows only the connected polygon lines and filled areas without point markers.
errors.description_zh: 数据点标记缺失。GT 图像在每个雷达多边形的每个类别顶点处显示圆形标记，而 Candidate 图像只显示了连接的多边形线条和填充区域，没有点标记。

errors.description: The candidate adds subplot titles 'Chanel', 'Dior', and 'Gucci' above the three radar charts. The ground truth has no individual subplot titles; the brand names appear only in the legend.

errors.description: The radial scale is not matched to the ground truth. In the ground truth the radial axis is fixed from 0 to 10, with the 9 tick inside the outer boundary; in the candidate the plotted scale visually ends much closer to the 9 tick, changing the apparent magnitude of the polygons.
errors.description_zh: 径向刻度与 GT 图像不匹配。在 GT 图像中，径向轴固定为 0 到 10，且 9 刻度位于外边界内侧；而在 Candidate 图像中，绘制的刻度在视觉上结束于更接近 9 刻度的位置，改变了多边形的表观大小。

errors.description: The radar gridlines use the wrong style. The ground truth has light solid gridlines, while the candidate uses gray dashed gridlines throughout the polar charts.
errors.description_zh: 雷达图网格线使用了错误的样式。GT 图像具有浅色实线网格线，而 Candidate 图像在整个极坐标图中使用灰色虚线网格线。

The large colored section/background regions are missing or not reconstructed. The ground truth has overlapping pale blue, green, and purple regions that group Input Sources, System Services, and Output Result Channels; the candidate uses a plain white background with isolated rectangular boxes instead.

The candidate uses small black sans-serif text throughout, whereas the ground truth uses large monospaced text with prominent blue/green/purple coloring, bold titles, and italic section headers. This substantially changes the characteristic visual style and hierarchy.

Most component boxes have the wrong color treatment. In the ground truth, boxes are mostly white with thick colored outlines and matching colored text, while the candidate uses filled pastel rectangles with thin black borders, changing the category encoding and visual fidelity.

errors.description: The major terrain layers use flat, mismatched colors instead of the ground truth gradients: the ocean/coastal band is a uniform teal rather than a left-to-right teal-to-blue gradient, the forest is uniform bright green rather than a green gradient, and the lithosphere is dark brown-orange rather than the brighter yellow-orange layer with red outline.

The layer boundaries are visibly misplaced: in the ground truth the ocean begins at y=300 and the lithosphere begins at y=385, while in the candidate the coastal band starts higher at about y=295 and the lithosphere starts higher at about y=380, changing the band heights.
The mountain range has the wrong appearance: the ground truth mountain is a reddish/orange gradient ellipse with a red outline, while the candidate uses a flat brown fill with a black outline.

subject: Computer Science

errors.description: The diagram title is missing. The ground-truth image has the title “Computer System - Block Relationship Diagram” across the top, while the candidate image starts directly with the CPU block and has no title text.
The light gray background panel is missing. The ground truth has a gray canvas behind the whole diagram, while the candidate is rendered on a plain white background.

The overall composition is laid out as a wide landscape diagram instead of the tall portrait layout in the ground truth. The candidate spreads RAM, ROM, Keyboard, Display, and External Storage much farther horizontally and vertically, changing the compact vertical block relationship structure.

The component colors and outlines do not match the ground truth. In the ground truth, blocks have pale fills with category-colored borders, such as dark-blue CPU border, red RAM border, green ROM border, purple I/O border, cyan Keyboard border, yellow Display border, and blue External Storage border; in the candidate, most block borders are black and several fills are different or more saturated.

All connector arrowheads are missing. The ground-truth relationships are dashed arrows with arrowheads pointing to target blocks, while the candidate shows plain dashed or solid lines without arrowheads.

The Data Bus connector is connected incorrectly. In the ground truth it is a vertical dashed arrow descending from the CPU, but in the candidate it is a horizontal dashed line extending left from the ROM and does not originate from the CPU.

errors.description: The rendered main title and three-line explanatory subtitle block are missing. In the ground truth they appear at the top-left, while the candidate only shows a small 'GDP Contribution (billions USD)' label and no visible title/subtitle text.
The chart background is light gray in the candidate, whereas the ground truth has a white background.
The y-axis tick labels 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, and 2,000 are absent in the candidate, removing the visible vertical scale shown in the ground truth.
The horizontal axis baseline and dashed horizontal gridlines are missing in the candidate. The ground truth shows a baseline at 0 and dashed gridlines at each major y tick.

The stacked bar segment values are incorrectly encoded. In the ground truth each sector has different segment heights within a year, with technology and finance much smaller near the top; in the candidate all five segments within a year are equal height, causing much taller stacks and clipping at the top for later years.

The sector colors do not match the ground truth palette. For example, Agriculture is teal in the candidate instead of dark blue, Industry is orange instead of red, Services is light green instead of green, Technology is blue instead of orange, and Finance is dark blue instead of purple.
The legend swatches use filled square boxes in the candidate, but the ground truth legend uses short dashed line samples for each sector.

errors.description: The overall solid is drawn with a substantially different projection and proportions: the ground truth is a compact, slightly slanted polyhedron with a wide horizontal lower edge and a shallow top, while the candidate is much taller and more steeply skewed, with the right face and top rim reshaped.

The O–T segment is wrong: in the ground truth it is a horizontal line across the upper front face from O to T, but in the candidate it is a long diagonal line descending from O toward the lower right.
An extra solid edge passes through r on the left side in the candidate. In the ground truth, r is an interior point connected only by dashed hidden lines, not a vertex on a solid V–O side edge.

The candidate shows several extra filled point markers at unlabeled intermediate positions, including a bottom-base point, multiple top-rim points, and an interior point near the dashed Q line; these markers are not present in the ground truth.
